relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blotting analysis showed that YC-1 and MCC950 significantly reduced the expression level of HIF-1α, NLRP3, Caspase-1 and cleaved caspase-1 the peri-thalamic lesion site of ITC rats compared to the control group

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Genetic knockdown of thalamic HIF-1α and NLRP3 significantly attenuated mechanical allodynia and anxiety- and depression-like behaviors following thalamic hemorrhage.

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: the content of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, and IL-33 in the peri-thalamic lesion site of ITC rats were lowered by YC-1 and MCC950

relationships.subject: Stellate ganglion block
relationships.evidence_quote: repetitive ipsilateral SGB significantly restored the upregulated HIF-1α/NLRP3 signaling and the hyperactivated microglia and astrocytes following thalamic hemorrhage

relationships.subject: YC-1
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest blocking HIF-1α and NLRP3 inhibited the hyperactivation of microglia and astrocytes after thalamic hemorrhagic stroke.

key_findings: Thalamic hemorrhage upregulates HIF-1α and NLRP3 in peri-thalamic tissue; knockdown or inhibition (YC-1, MCC950) prevents allodynia, anxiodepressive behavior, glial activation and cytokines.
Repetitive stellate ganglion block reverses CPSP and HIF-1α/NLRP3 signaling and increases cerebral blood flow.
